Comrade General the Germans are trying to break through our positions in the Kursk salient! Marshall Zhukov has put you in charge of the northern flank of our defenses! You should stop the enemy short of Ponyri Station!
Commander, though able to achieve some limited success, most of the German troops escaped to fight on. We expected more from you.
Comrade General you have failed to stop the Germans completely! Ponyri Station is still threatened! Vassiliev is not pleased with your performance!
Orel (RTB#07)
August 12, 1943
The Soviets counterattack to take the German held salient of Orel.
Comrade General you have achieved complete success! The German are leaving Orel at full speed! We have them on the run!
Comrade General you have failed to achieve complete success! The German are evacuating Orel at in good order! Marshall Zhukov is displeased with your luckluster performance!
Good work comrade, we have defeated the allied armies in Belgium, however, the allied leaders have escaped from us.

Comrade, your counterattack has sent the enemy reeling, but, at the same time your men have suffered severe losses.  Nevertheless, the Red Army now holds the initiative.  It is the beginning of the end of the fascists. Comrade, to the west!
Comrade General the Germans are trying to establish an stable front on the right bank of the Dnepr river. We should penetrate this "Eastern wall" and gain a sure foothold on the other bank.
Dnepr Crossing (RTB#09)
September 13, 1943
Soviet offensive to cross the Dnepr river and breach the German Eastern wall.

Comrade General you have failed to disrupt the German plans! You undecided attack just established some beachheads here and there, but you failed to breach the Eastern wall! Vassiliev is very displeased! You have to do better!
January 12, 1945
Crossing Vistula River opens the road to conquest of Warsaw and approach to the Oder River.
WWII ½: Counterattack-Riposte - July 1, 1945
General, the Soviets are still advancing in the British sector.
Apparently, they don't feel threatened by our attacks against their flank.
Lets make them pay for that cockiness.
Comrade General you have achieved a great success! The German position is in disarray by the big beachhead you established on the right bank of the Dnepr river in the junction of both Army Groups.

Comrade General: Comrade Stalin is extremely pleased with your performance!!! Nazi Germany is no more and Anglo-americans are far from Berlin!!! You are one of the heroes of the hour and a new Marshall of the Soviet Union!!!
Comrade General you have achieved a tremendous success! You have broken the siege of Leningrad and the Germans are on the run! Vassiliev is extremely pleased!

Comrade General you have achieved a tremendous success! You have broken the siege of Leningrad, but your indecision allowed the Germans to withdraw in good order! Vassiliev is very displeased with your failure in following up your success!
The Soviets attempt to surround the new German Sixth Army at Cherkassy in the Ukraine.
Well you did it, but at a very high cost.
I don't think the Soviets know how exposed we are here and have
asked for terms.
Comrade General you were able to push the Germans from Perekop, but the German-Romanian forces are still resisting us! STAVKA is not pleased with your performance!
March 15, 1944
Soviets offensive in the  Northwestern Ukraine.
Truman rejects Yalta Agreements and decides to liberate Berlin before the Soviets but Nazi Germany still shows stiff resistance.

Comrade General, in reward of your bravery and devotion Comrade Stalin on Marshal Zhukov's proposal has charged you with the task of assaulting Berlin!!! For your courage you've been again awarded with the Hero of the Soviet Union. Hurrah!!!

Comrade General STAVKA needs you to straighten the operations leading to the surrender of Sevastopol. The local commanders have botched the attack. You can deploy only six of your units plus your Air Force. You will have also support from the Black Sea Fleet. Do not fail us Comrade!
Comrade General you have achieved a great success! The enemy has surrendered and finally Crimea is free from invaders! STAVKA is very pleased with your command of the operation!
Comrade General you have achieved some success, but your ineptitude has allowed the enemy to evacuate the city by sea! Vassiliev is displeased even though you captured the city!
Comrade General you have achieved a great victory! You stopped the German counterattacks and took Budapest! Hungary has surrendered!
Comrade General you have achieved a great success! The enemy has surrendered and Finland has asked for an armistice! STAVKA is very pleased with your command of the operation!
June 7,1944
The Russians attack the Finns at Viipuri. A victory here will put Finland out of the war.
August 7,1944
Soviet attempt to defeat the  German-Romanian South Ukraine Army Group and knock Romania out of the war.
Comrade General: Comrade Stalin is not pleased with your lackluster performance. Your next assigment is at the Manchurian border. You have not understood our doctrine well enough!!!
The Germans attempt to push through the Australian and New Zealand
lines on the way to Athens, Greece.
Comrade General you have crossed the Dniestr, but most Axis troops have been evacuated and Romania still opposes us! Vassiliev is not pleased!

Comrade General: This is your opportunity to expel the German facists from Russian territory!!! Comrade Stalin wants to destroy Army Group Center once and for all. You will attack in the direction of Minsk. Two tanks and four rifle armies will support you.
Comrade General: Comrade Stalin is very pleased with your performance!!! You have recovered Belorussia for us!!!
Comrade General: Comrade Stalin is not please with your lackluster performance. Your next assigment is at the Manchurian border. You have not understood our doctrine well enough!!!
October 17,1944
The Russians attack the northern flank of Army Group Center trying to
open a direct path into Germany through East Prussia.
Good work.  You hit a  home run!  Now, we've got men and machines rolling into southern Italy, and rumor has it that Italy's on the verge of surrendering.  Nice going, Commander.
A fourth year plebe could have done better than that General.
If you let me down again, you'll wish you were a plebe again.
The Seelow Heights marked the last place before Berlin offering good
defensive terrain for the German forces.
Only their deep desire for revenge and to crush the German political
leadership drove the Soviet armies forward.
Comrade General Vassiliev has asked for you to direct the operations of
the Ukrainian and Belorussian Fronts that will cross the Vistula river
and will aim directly to the heart of Germany. We expect much of you! Do not dissapoint us Comrade!

Comrade General you have achieved a tremendous success! You have broken the German Central front. The Germans are on the run and most of Poland is in our hands, our borders are secured for a long time! Vassiliev is extremely pleased!

Comrade General you crossed the Vistula river but after that your indecision has allowed the Germans to rebuild their positions!!! This compromises our future operations. Vassiliev is very displeased!
January 15,1945
Soviet offensive to take Budapest and clear from German troops the Hungarian plains.
Hungary, the last German ally will be knocked out of the war.
Excellent! Rommel has been driven back from El Alamein, the threat to Egypt is over. One small push should drive them back to Tripoli.

Comrade General you have achieved only a small victory! You stopped the German counterattacks, but failed to take Budapest and allowed the Germans to estabilize the front! Hungary is still defying us!
Comrade General: Vassiliev has asked for you to direct the attack on the
Oder Front. A victory here will open the door to Berlin! Do not dissapoint
us Comrade! Victory is very close!
Comrade General you have achieved a tremendous victory! You have broken the German Ninth and Third Panzer Armies! Berlin is in front of us! Vassiliev is extremely pleased!
Comrade General you have achieved some success! Once again your
dilatory tactics failed to achieve a decisive breakthrough though! As a
result Anglo-Americans changed their mind, they will not meet Yalta's
agreements and are rushing on Berlin under the pretext of helping us.
Vassiliev is extremely displeased! In consideration of served services to
the Rodina you will still direct operations of the final assault on Berlin.
You got lucky of avoiding Siberia! You will not get once more a second
chance. Failure is not an option!
Soviet direct attack on Berlin. Victory will mean the end of Nazi Germany.
Hitler declared Berlin "Fortress Town".
Stavka puts Koniev (Southern Army Group) and Zukov (Central Army Group) in competition for the capture of the Nazi lair.
Stalin orders to hang the Soviet flag at the top of the Reichtag before May, 1st.

Comrade General: The time for revenge has arrived! The last German troops try desperately to defend Berlin. Stavka orders you to take the city at any cost! In no way decadent anglo-americans may reach the city before us, the Great Patriotic War has been the suffering of the whole Soviet people, those "allies" cannot steal our deserved victory. Don't waste time! Hitler is supposed to remain in the City, he must be found dead or alive. His bunker has still not been located. Find it, this is your second objective.  Expect fanatic resistance. Unleash Hell. Failure is not an option Comrade General. The eyes of the Rodina are watching you!
Comrade General: Comrade Stalin is pleased with your performance! Despite some indecisions you were able to destroy Nazi Germany!!! Unfortunately we do not know about Hitler's fate!!!
Soviet offensive to clear the Leningrad area across the Narva river.
Comrade General your wonderful victory has dealt a tremendous blow to Army Group North! Vassiliev is very pleased with your performance!
Comrade General you were able to push the Germans across the Narva river, but Army Group North is still intact opposing us! Vassiliev is not pleased with your performance!
Comrade General Your success has liberated the city of Riga and most of Latvia! Marshall Zhukov has proposed a promotion for you to Colonel General!
Comrade General you were able to push the Germans from most Latvia, but Army Group North is still intact in the Curland area! Vassiliev is not pleased with your performance!
Perekop (RTB#25)
November 10, 1943
The Soviet troops attack the city of Perekop to cut the land
communication between Ukraine and the Crimean peninsula.
The assault on Monte Cassino has succeeded and we can breach the line at our current strength. Unfortunately the landings at Anzio have not gone ahead as expected.
October 7, 1943
Soviet attack to liberate Kiev, the capital of the SSR Ukraine.

Comrade General: Kiev the Ukrainian capital is in front of you. This is your opportunity to expel the German facists from the second most important Soviet Republic!!! Comrade Stalin wants to destroy Army Group South once and for all. You will attack from above and below the city.
WWII ½: Counterattack Part 3

In no way decadent anglo-americans may reach the city before us, the Great Patriotic War has been the suffering of the whole Soviet people, those "allies" cannot steal our deserved victory. Don't waste time! Hitler is supposed to remain in the City, he must be found dead or alive. His bunker has still not been located. Find it, this is your second objective.  Expect fanatic resistance. Unleash Hell! Failure is not an option Comrade General. The eyes of the Rodina are watching you!

You have succeeded in your mission where many others would have failed.  However, the Afrika Korps and its Italian Allies have been able to withdraw most of their troops where they will be a potent threat to future operations.

Poronaisk

Comrade General: Comrade Stalin is displeased with your performance! Anglo-Americans took Berlin, we must now share victory with them as bright second class partner!!! Furthermore we do not know about Hitler's fate!!!
Comrade General: Comrade Stalin is very pleased with your performance!!! Koenigsberg and Danzig have lived, Kaliningrad and Gdansk are born, our borders are now secured for a long time!!!
Commander, you did a fine job. However, our forces are losing ground everywhere. You must withdraw you men to Dunkirk to be evacuated. We cannot afford to lose you or your men!
The British resistance into the British streets has been really hard, but finally we get the control over the city. Now we are controlling most of the South East coast of England.
March 22, 1945
For the very first time Russians cross the German border.
Osterode i.O.
Comrade General: You had the honour beeing the first Red Army
General to cross the German border, now you have the privilege to force Prussian capital to surrender!!! The hour of revenge has come!!!
Nazi Germany is weakened but still dangerous. Expect fanatic resistance.
Koenigsberg and Danzig are heavily fortified.
Watch out, a few Kriegsmarine units are nearby as mobile artillery...
By the way bring souvenirs to Stalin once Rastenburg, the so-called
Wolfschanze will be conquered.
The invasion of this southern area of England has been succesfully, a beachhead has been established, and now our army can fully disembark. Good Work, Stalin is delighted with your actions.
January 14,1945
The Russians attack Warsaw whereas Germans crushed the Poles during Warsaw uprising in October 1944.
A victory here will allow crossing over the Vistula River to the Oder.

You are stupid!, you have destroyed all the operation with your horrible actions!, now it's supposed that we surely would start the evacuation of all the beach-heads before the British could make a counter-attack. A Military Council is already waiting for you in Germany!.
Comrade General: This is the opportunity to liberate Polish peasants and

workers from Fascism!!! Polish resistants fought in Warsaw a few months ago without coordination with the Red Army. Our supply lines were overextended and it was not worth fighting without proper logistics, we had to rest and refit.

Our supply lines are now secured. Some remnants of partisan units during Warsaw Uprising last October are probably still in town, you are authorized to assist them but in no way this "parameter" may jeopardize comand of tactical operations. Stavka orders you to follow the axis line Warsaw-Poznan and to clear this area from Germans. For political reasons some Polish regular units of Berling's Army will assist you, those are temporarily under your command, use them wisely. Expel definitely Fascists from Warsaw!!!
Comrade General: Comrade Stalin is very pleased with your performance!!! Warsaw belongs to us, now we can move to the Oder river!!!
You have dealt the German Army a crippling blow. However, the sacrifice of Tenth Panzer allowed other german ubits to overwhelm our forces at Arnhem. All your good work was in vain.
August 20,1944
Soviet offensive to take Bucharest and knock Romania out of the war.
Rumany will be be forced to reverse its alliance with German fascists and to fight on Soviet side.
That was Ok General,
You were slow to cutoff Berlin making Monty's job harder, but he got the
job done.

Comrade General: Comrade Stalin is very pleased with your performance!!! The Romanian troops have surrendered and Romania has asked for an armistice! Soviet Republic of Moldavia is born, our borders are now secured for a long time!!!
I am aware that conditions have been harsh, but you have done poorly!  We have been forced to evacuate our troops from Norway. Hopefully you will fare better in the future Commander.
October 14, 1944
After fall of Rumania and Bulgaria, Germans are on the run.
The Red Army and Tito's partisans are liberating Belgrade together.
Retreat route of Army Group E must be cut off by 3rd Ukrainian Front.
Comrade General: Fall of Rumania and Bulgaria gave us the opportunity to free Yugoslav workers and peasants!!! You will join your forces with Malinovsky 3rd Ukrainian front and Tito's partisans!!!
Your orders are to cut off retreating route of German Army Group E.
Comrade General: Comrade Stalin is very pleased with your performance!!! Communist doctrine has gained a precious ally in the Balkans!!!
You jeopardized our diplomatic relations with Marshall Tito!!!
Your next assigment is at the Manchurian border. You have not understood our doctrine well enough!!!
April 10, 1944
Soviet forces aim to retreive Odessa harbour facilities from Rumanian and German troops.

Comrade General STAVKA needs you to straighten the operations leading to the surrender of Odessa. You will get reinforcements, shore landings will be organized near Usatavo town. You will have also support from the Black Sea Fleet. Do not fail us Comrade!
You're not worth to be "comrade". Comrade Stalin ordered to assault, but you were so slow and clumsy, that Nazis could regroup and counterattack. So, you shall be courtmartialled.
Auschwitz Liberation
January 27, 1945
Liberation of Auchwitz concentration camp by Soviet forces.

Comrade General: Fall of Katowice allows us to liberate Auschwitz concentration camp. Anglo-Americans urge us to deliver deportees. Small forces have been allocated for this operation, Stavka cannot divert its core forces from other fronts. Use a small detachment and capture the camp, this should be a piece of cake while Germans are on the run. Stalin count especially on you, his prestige is at stake, failure is not an option.

Comrade General: Comrade Stalin is very pleased with your performance!!! The world will remember that the Red Army liberated people from the most terrific Nazi extermination camp. This capture is an operation which will greatly benefit to the spread of our doctrine.

Comrade General, you have arrived early.  We can begin our meeting now.  The samovar has just been refilled if you would like a drink.  Very good.  Let us begin.  The historical dialectic propounded by Marx and Lenin and refined by the Great Stalin has proven its inevitable truth.  The fascist invaders of our homeland have over-extended themselves in a futile attempt to seize the city of Stalingrad.  Here along the Chir River, you and your forces will surge through their defenses and drive southward with maximum speed.  The Red Army of workers and peasants will surround the enemy and force his surrender.

Good work, Comrade, very good!  Thanks to your proper understanding of party doctrine, you have been able to accomplish your mission.  The fascist invaders are trapped without any hope of escape.  Now, prepare yourself and your men to drive them out of the Motherland.

This is good, Comrade General!  Thanks to your proper understanding of party doctrine, you have been able to accomplish your mission.  The fascist invaders are trapped without any hope of escape.  Now, prepare yourself and your men to drive them out of the motherland.

Your failure to follow the clear directives of the Party's Central Committee has resulted in a grievous defeat.  You are therefore to report to Yakutsk, to study further the writings of Marx, Lenin and the Great Stalin.

Good news, Comrade General.  The fascist offensive has been halted.  Now is the time for our counter-offensive.  You have been selected to drive the fascists back.  The Red Army of workers and peasants will triumph!
